messages:
Maya (People Ops): quick sync 1 we've merged a small but important handbook update under 'Hiring Ops & Background Checks' -> added clearer step-by-step for contract vs perm offers + timeline expectations. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/hiring-ops 
Tom (Recruiting): are we changing background check vendors or just the process language?
Maya (People Ops): process language only for now. Two clarifications: 1) offer acceptance now requires candidate to acknowledge background check window (5 business days) and 2) recruiters must mark 'bg-check-started' in ATS to kick off compliance tracking.
Aisha (Legal): Note: updated consent language for CA residents added. Recruiters, use the CA consent template in the ATS when state==CA.
Tom (Recruiting): ok i'll update our offer template and run a sweep for in-flight offers today. What about contractor hiring timelines?
Maya (People Ops): contractors: shorter vetting checklist (no formal background check unless the role requires access to sensitive customer data). Updated checklist in the doc.
Carlos (Eng): small ops question: does this affect security onboarding flow? we trigger access provisioning after BG clear. If recruiters mark started but BG takes >5 days, can engineers request provisional access?
Maya (People Ops): provisional access is allowed for low-risk non-prod infra only and requires signed provisional access form + manager approval. I've added the form link to the handbook and created a quick ticket template.
Tom (Recruiting): action items: 1) I'll update ATS templates, 2) sweeping in-flight offers, 3) tag any CA candidates for new consent. Reply with "ACK" when done.
compliance-bot: Task created: "Hiring Ops handbook acknowledgment" assigned to hiring-managers. Due in 7 days.
Aisha (Legal): also FYI we've added a short FAQ about international data residency for candidate records. Keep candidate docs in the region-specific bucket per the guide.
Carlos (Eng): ACK 1 will hold off on provisioning until BG clears or provisional form in place.
Tom (Recruiting): ACK 1 templates updated and in-flight sweep started. Will DM Maya any edge cases.
Maya (People Ops): thanks team 1 i'll follow up with a 1-pager and a 10-min microlearning for recruiters/hiring managers. training-bot will assign it to those roles once i publish.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Complete Hiring Ops microlearning" will notify assigned users 3 days before due date.
